purpose: Synthetic multi-grammar corpus for the graphy.lightning parity goldens and grammar tests (P4 pass 1). Every byte is marker-clean by construction.

files.alpha.py: python grammar - nested named blocks (module fn, class, method) for the innermost-named anchor rule; three resolve_widget occurrences
files.beta.js: brace-language grammar (pseudo_ast lane) - function/object-method nesting; resolve_widget + camelCase sibling for fuzzy splinter
files.gamma.svelte: svelte grammar - script block function + reactive statement
files.server.log: uvicorn access-line grammar - log_route blocks incl. a query-string line for the route_query_pattern case
files.transcript.md: session-prose grammar - the '--- [N] USER/ASSISTANT' delimiter blocks

notes: The goldens are minted over this corpus by scripts/mint_lightning_goldens.sh (host-side lane); see each golden's oracle_commit and mint_command for re-derivation.
